correctness.rationale: Exhaustive nine-pair affine-reflection classification gives regenerative resets of probability 2q(1-q), exact recurrence E(U_next²)=(1-theta)U²+d²(1-q)/2 and full-state coalescence. The two geometric tails solve the off-center and reset-center balance equations, normalize, and yield the exact characteristic function. Levy continuity proves the Laplace limit. The r=1 Kaczmarz projection law gives floor d²/4, while RrDR gives d²/(4q). Verifier tests exact pair algebra and 48 exact finite-time moment recurrences over four rational profiles; computational checks are finite corroboration, not proof of the infinite statements.

value.rationale: The smallest full-column-rank inconsistent case in R² needs at least three equations, and the adopted row norms determine q naturally. Even though the invariant mean is exactly the unique least-squares solution, the published r=2 solver pays an arbitrarily high exact 1/q squared-error cost over its r=1 Kaczmarz specialization. The complete invariant law and q-to-zero Laplace scaling explain why rare orthogonal updates create broad stationary excursions; this is a meaningful diagnostic for randomized numerical linear solvers, not a generic distribution naming exercise.
